finalText:
Builds clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it hands to your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on `undefined.toFixed()` and crashed the link stage.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` required `backoffEnabled` to be strictly `true` or `false`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, which used to come through as `false` — so it threw instead. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled, matching the old behavior.

The rest is just deprecation warnings (`Buffer()`, `punycode`, sync loader hooks, etc.) — 8 total, none blocking. Build finishes at "8 warnings, 0 errors."
